publication_boundary: Includes current docs/evidence-only pending publication after implementation HEAD. Containing Git commit identifies the final evidence publication.
hash_kind: raw_sha256 records exact working bytes. git_index_blob_sha256 records canonical Git index bytes; product source line-ending filtering is explicit. Raw evidence must match staged blobs exactly.

files.note: Manifest itself listed but excluded from its own hash.

excluded: baseline regression worktree and external dependencies

staged_raw_evidence_byte_check.method: Single git cat-file --batch; compare exact staged blob SHA256 against captured disk SHA256.
